scope: Exact list of remote-only files for root to copy so the complex analysis cut's source, overlays and binding receipts survive off the source host. destination_rule: destination = destination_root + '/' + source_relative; mirrors the remote layout so job names stay recognisable
copy_procedure: Refuse if destination_root already exists; never overwrite.
For every row in copy_required (then copy_recommended, copy_optional if root chooses): hash the source on the host and refuse unless it equals sha256 and bytes.
Copy, then hash the source again (unchanged) and the local destination (equal).
Write destination_root/receipt.json in the receipt214 form: utc, source_host, source_root, files {source_relative: sha256}, source_unchanged_before_after_copy, scope.
Do not git add: rows with destination_gitignored true would be dropped silently, and several files carry absolute host paths.
